architecture.state_machine: UNREGISTERED -> REGISTERED/ADOPTED -> ORIENTATION -> PENDING OPERATOR AUTHORIZATION -> AUTHORIZED -> ACTIVE LEASE -> EXPIRED/REVOKED/INVALIDATED
architecture.guard: hybrid portable policy core plus protected local guard/service plus thin adapters
architecture.operator_proof: canonical request digest plus protected user-presence signature; check-frozen --ack and chat text are not proof
architecture.delegation: strict subset of parent authority with binding, expiry, depth, lineage, and inherited revocation
architecture.identity: adoption binding plus Git common-dir/root/contract digest; remote is corroborating only

platforms.windows: protected service/named pipe plus CNG/DPAPI and Job Objects or equivalent confinement
platforms.linux: systemd or daemon plus Unix socket peer credentials and namespace/Landlock/sandbox backends
platforms.macos: launchd/XPC plus Keychain/Secure Enclave and sandbox/EndpointSecurity or managed wrapper

architecture.repair: narrow operator-approved diagnosed-scope lease; no general implementation or trust authority
architecture.product_boundary: vendor-neutral OSS RepoPact; external products and ForgeWire Fabric are downstream adapters only
